title: fix(app-shell): Home, the app switcher and launcher blocks offer only the apps /me/apps lists, so a tabPermissions-hidden app draws no tile
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8X61MrFcMwootjvrLF4Py6o)_
Fixes #26838

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:首页磁贴、应用切换器菜单和 `app:launcher` 页面块都按当前用户的 `GET /me/apps` 结果收窄应用列表,权限集里 `tabPermissions: hidden` 的应用不再出现。
- 为什么改:隐藏只在 `/me/apps` 生效,而这三个入口都读 `/meta/app`(卡上说切换器已正确,实测它也读 `/meta/app`),成员仍能看到并点开被管理员隐藏的应用。
- 风险与回滚:无安全插件时 `/me/apps` 答 404、或读取失败,一律回退到原来的完整列表;首页多等一次 `/me/apps` 首读。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useLauncherApps.tsx`(收窄与回退规则)、`ui/apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`(唯一挂载点)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx`(首页等待首读)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/home/__tests__/HomePage.launcherHiddenApps-26838.test.tsx`,预期 4 个用例通过,被隐藏的 Showcase 不出磁贴。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useLauncherApps.tsx`:
  - `LauncherAppsProvider` reads `GET /api/v1/me/apps` once per signed-in user, and again only when the active `/meta/app` name set gains a name the held answer was not asked about (an install or a publish mid-session).
  - `useLauncherApps(apps)` returns `filterActiveApps(apps)` minus every app the answer was asked about and did not list. The entries stay `/meta/app`'s own objects (labels, icons, `_packageId`, publish state); `/me/apps` contributes names only.
  - No provider, a `404` (no security plugin serves the route) or a failed read narrows nothing. A failure other than `404` logs one `console.warn`; a `404` is not asked again for that user.
  - `pending` is true only while the first read is out.
- `ui/apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`: `ConsolePermissionsScope`, the one common ancestor of `/home` and `/apps/:appName/*`, mounts `LauncherAppsProvider` inside `MePermissionsProvider`, with the same server URL and authenticated fetch. The seat extended the claim's file surface to this file (amendment 6457698059).
- `HomePage`: the tiles and the System Settings link come from `useLauncherApps`; the page's loading gate also waits for the first read, so a hidden tile is never drawn and then removed. The host-app resolution and the recent rows' app labels keep the full active list, because a hidden app still opens.
- `AppSwitcher`: the menu lists `useLauncherApps(apps)`. The pill still names a hidden app while the user is in it (its existing fallback over all active apps).
- `app:launcher` block (`views/app-launcher-renderer.tsx`): its openable set is `useLauncherApps(apps)`; it still issues no request of its own.
- `LauncherAppsProvider` and `useLauncherApps` are exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- Changeset `.changeset/26838-launcher-hidden-tabs.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console` patch.

Not changed: no server change, no route guard (a hidden app keeps opening from its URL), `default_off` untouched, `console/appObjectScope.ts` untouched.

### Why a provider, not a hook that fetches

No `@objectstack/client` method reads `/me/apps`, so the read is a direct authenticated fetch. The ui network-escape guard (`ui/vitest.setup.network-escape-guard.ts`) reds any test whose render reaches a relative fetch, and about 130 test files render `HomePage`, `AppSwitcher`, `AppHeader` or `HomeLayout`. An explicitly mounted provider, the `MePermissionsProvider` pattern, keeps those tests unchanged: without it a surface reads the unnarrowed list, exactly as before.

## Tests

- `hooks/__tests__/useLauncherApps-26838.test.tsx` (8 cases): narrows by the answer and keeps the `/meta/app` entries; no provider narrows nothing; `404` narrows nothing, silently, and is not re-asked; `500` narrows nothing and warns once; `pending` only for the first read; an app added after the read passes and triggers one re-read; two consumers share one read; no user, no read.
- `console/home/__tests__/HomePage.launcherHiddenApps-26838.test.tsx` (4 cases): `/meta/app` = [setup, crm, showcase_app] and `/me/apps` = [setup, crm] draws no Showcase tile; a set hiding Setup removes the System Settings link; the `404` control draws every tile; the loading line holds while the first read is out.
- `layout/__tests__/AppSwitcher.launcherHiddenApps-26838.test.tsx` (3 cases): the hidden app is not in the menu; the `404` control lists it; the pill still names it when the user is in it.

<details><summary>Ablations (one-time; restored, blob equals HEAD each time)</summary>

Each leg ran under the lock through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 -> 0, restored blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), on commit `9f4f6f31`:

- `HomePage.tsx`: the tiles from `activeApps` instead of `launcher.apps` -> `HomePage.launcherHiddenApps-26838`: 2 failed / 2 passed (the hidden-tile case and the loading-hold case go red).
- `useLauncherApps.tsx`: the narrowing predicate replaced by `return true` -> hook, Home and switcher files: 7 cases red across the three files.
- `AppSwitcher.tsx`: the menu from the old inline `active`/`hidden` filter -> `AppSwitcher.launcherHiddenApps-26838`: 2 failed / 1 passed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **CommandPalette app list** (`console/home/HomeLayout.tsx` passes `apps ?? []`; the in-app palette likewise) still lists a tab-hidden app. Left for the seat to decide whether it is a launcher surface that needs a card.
- **Default-app landing** in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` (`launcherApps` there, used when the URL names no app) still filters `active`/`hidden` only, so `/apps` with no segment can land on a tab-hidden app. Not touched: hot shared file, not a launcher surface.
- **Card premise correction**: the card says the app switcher reads `/me/apps` and hides the app. On `origin/main` no file under `ui/` read `/me/apps`; the switcher read `/meta/app` like Home. Both are fixed here.
- **Observation, not filed**: `GET /me/apps` answers `200 { apps: [] }` when its handler throws (the outer `catch` in `current-user-endpoints.ts`), which this client cannot tell from "every app is hidden"; on that answer Home shows no tiles. Read-only inference from source; not reproduced.
- Home now waits for the first `/me/apps` read alongside `/meta/app`; the read starts once the app list has loaded, so it adds one request round trip before the tiles draw on a cold load.

## Verification

All on head `cbe8d370` (origin/main merged in), app-shell closure built first (7m33s under the lock).

- New tests: 3 files, 15/15 passed.
- Affected set: every app-shell and console test file that names `HomePage`, `AppSwitcher`, `AppHeader`, `HomeLayout`, `ConsoleLayout`, `AppContent`, the launcher block or the hook, plus all of `console/home/__tests__` and `layout/__tests__`: 284 files, 2359 tests passed (on `9f4f6f31`, before the merge of origin/main, which touched no file under these paths).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check`: exit 0 (after `--filter '@object-ui/console^...' build`).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 34 derived commands, each exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Includes `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` (exit 0) and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (exit 0).
- Also run: `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:test-path-roots`: exit 0.
- CI owns the repo lint and the remaining type-check lanes.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI runs the repo lint)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
